title: Highly tunable TetR-dependent target gene expression in the acetic acid bacterium Gluconobacter oxydans.
authors: Fricke, Philipp Moritz; Lurkens, Martha; Hunnefeld, Max; Sonntag, Christiane K; Bott, Michael; Davari, Mehdi D; Polen, Tino
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Gluconobacter oxydans中TetR/LacI调控表达系统，含蛋白-DNA结合模拟，但核心是基因表达工程而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法为计算模拟且深度有限。
abstract: For the acetic acid bacterium (AAB) Gluconobacter oxydans only recently the first tight system for regulatable target gene expression became available based on the heterologous repressor-activator protein AraC from Escherichia coli and the target promoter P(araBAD). In this study, we tested pure repressor-based TetR- and LacI-dependent target gene expression in G. oxydans by applying the same plasmid backbone and construction principles that we have used successfully for the araC-P(araBAD) system. When using a pBBR1MCS-5-based plasmid, the non-induced basal expression of the Tn10-based TetR-dependent expression system was extremely low. This allowed calculated induction ratios of up to more than 3500-fold with the fluorescence reporter protein mNeonGreen (mNG). The induction was highly homogeneous and tunable by varying the anhydrotetracycline concentration from 10 to 200 ng/mL. The already strong reporter gene expression could be doubled by inserting the ribosome binding site AGGAGA into the 3' region of the P(tet) sequence upstream from mNG. Alternative plasmid constructs used as controls revealed a strong influence of transcription terminators and antibiotics resistance gene of the plasmid backbone on the resulting expression performance. In contrast to the TetR-P(tet)-system, pBBR1MCS-5-based LacI-dependent expression from P(lacUV5) always exhibited some non-induced basal reporter expression and was therefore tunable only up to 40-fold induction by IPTG. The leakiness of P(lacUV5) when not induced was independent of potential read-through from the lacI promoter. Protein-DNA binding simulations for pH 7, 6, 5, and 4 by computational modeling of LacI, TetR, and AraC with DNA suggested a decreased DNA binding of LacI when pH is below 6, the latter possibly causing the leakiness of LacI-dependent systems hitherto tested in AAB. In summary, the expression performance of the pBBR1MCS-5-based TetR-P(tet) system makes this system highly suitable for applications in G. oxydans and possibly in other AAB. KEY POINTS: * A pBBR1MCS-5-based TetR-P(tet) system was tunable up to more than 3500-fold induction. * A pBBR1MCS-5-based LacI-P(lacUV5) system was leaky and tunable only up to 40-fold. * Modeling of protein-DNA binding suggested decreased DNA binding of LacI at pH < 6.
abstract_zh: 对于醋酸菌（AAB）氧化葡萄糖酸杆菌（Gluconobacter oxydans），直到最近才基于来自大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）的异源阻遏-激活蛋白AraC和目标启动子P(araBAD)开发出首个严格的靶基因表达调控系统。在本研究中，我们采用与成功应用于araC-P(araBAD)系统相同的质粒骨架和构建原理，测试了G. oxydans中基于纯阻遏蛋白的TetR和LacI依赖性靶基因表达。当使用基于pBBR1MCS-5的质粒时，基于Tn10的TetR依赖性表达系统的非诱导基础表达极低。这使得使用荧光报告蛋白mNeonGreen（mNG）的计算诱导比率可达3500倍以上。该诱导过程高度均一，并可通过将脱水四环素浓度从10 ng/mL调整至200 ng/mL进行调控。通过将核糖体结合位点AGGAGA插入到mNG上游P(tet)序列的3'区域，已较强的报告基因表达可进一步加倍。用作对照的替代质粒构建体揭示了转录终止子和质粒骨架抗生素抗性基因对最终表达性能的强烈影响。与TetR-P(tet)系统相比，基于pBBR1MCS-5的LacI依赖性P(lacUV5)表达始终表现出一定的非诱导基础报告基因表达，因此仅能通过IPTG实现最多40倍的诱导。P(lacUV5)在未诱导时的渗漏表达与lacI启动子的潜在通读无关。通过计算建模LacI、TetR和AraC与DNA在pH 7、6、5和4下的蛋白质-DNA结合模拟表明，当pH低于6时，LacI的DNA结合能力下降，后者可能是迄今在AAB中测试的LacI依赖性系统渗漏的原因。总之，基于pBBR1MCS-5的TetR-P(tet)系统的表达性能使其高度适用于G. oxydans及其他可能的AAB中的应用。要点：* 基于pBBR1MCS-5的TetR-P(tet)系统可实现超过3500倍的诱导调控。* 基于pBBR1MCS-5的LacI-P(lacUV5)系统存在渗漏，仅能实现最多40倍的诱导。* 蛋白质-DNA结合模拟表明，在pH < 6时LacI的DNA结合能力下降。
